## Expression on this line

Economic Systems at amber Stage 9 is the **modern-market-with-patrimonial-allocation**: a
modern market apparatus has consolidated — banks, corporate-and-regulatory law, regulators
with statutory reach, formal capital-markets, a tax-and-budget-cadre, modern logistics and
currency — but the *actual* allocation of capital-and-license-and-state-resource typically
runs on loyalty, kinship, and ruling-order-membership rather than on impersonal competition.

The constitutive choice is to give the modern-market apparatus a *sacralized distribution
logic*: who-gets-what-and-when is decided by in-group-membership first and foremost. The
modern market is *instrument-in-the-service-of* an in-group project — those that fit the
group are beneficiaries of allocation; those that don't fit are excluded. The illusion of
modern-arm's-length discipline is kept polished because the planned cycle-stability of the
in-group project requires it. The economics discipline is professionalized-modern but the
allocation mechanism is inherited-loyalty.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from amber-9)

- **UL:** the practitioner's professional craftsmanship in the modern-economics discipline;
  the craftsman-economist's dignity.
- **UR:** modern market infrastructure: banks, corporate-and-regulatory law, formal capital-
  markets, fiscal discipline, regulatory apparat.
- **LL:** the in-group-sacral project bears the operational-distribution logic; the shared-
  modern-economic polity has the available-and-useful-discipline nor the in-group project.
- **LR:** codified corporate-and-criminal law, statutory regulatory regime, tax-and-budget
  discipline, corporate-statutory-scaffolding.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to amber-9):** **patrimonial capture** — the modern-market apparatus
  remains in-form but operates in-distribution as a partisan-and-favor-driven allocation form;
  the modern-arm's-length becomes costume-over-inheritance.
- **Dark allergy (amber-9 foundation skipped/fragile):** modern market-statute-without-modern-
  regulatory-statute-versus-clients; market-and-currency without effective-statute-discipline;
  regulatory-without-statute-discipline-and-set-cap.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Orange prematurely):** **market-liberal-statistical theater** —
  modern-market-statistical-language (independence-of-central-bank-statistical, applied-
  market-rule, etc.) while the operative distribution runs on in-group-membership; orange-
  form, amber-substance.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing the Orange emergence):** nativist-refusal of the worldcentric
  market-as-public-discipline; "we do economics in our way", refusing the orange step of
  accepting market-as-public-domain subjugated to rights-equal-procedure.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place an economic-system holon at **amber Stage 9**.

- **Allocation-membership-coverage pattern.** Patterns of capital-and-license-and-state-resource
  allocation correlated with in-group-membership markings rather than with impersonal-statute-
  applicable assessments; *fit-to-in-group* is the dominant signal.
- **Public-procurement fit-membership signal.** Trends-of-public-procurement findings correlated
  with political-and-managerial-affiliation rather than with bid-fit, with monitor-statistical
  published on findings-of-upheld-complaint.
- **Bank-credit fit-membership signal.** Trends-of-bank-credit-disbursement correlated with
  collateral-fit-for-membership attest; collateral-statistical-fit scoring affects lower
  minorities disproportionately.
- **Statutory-regulator-cap statistical signal.** A regulator-statute-system that has cap-
  statutory-and-effective-limit lower than the cross-economy rate; recurrent-statute-amendment-
  precedent applied to non-aligned operators.
- **In-group-statistical-coverage.** Recurrent-statistical-occurrence of in-group-coverage;
  recurrent stat-publication on the discriminated-out-group-class.
- **Statutory-fiscal discipline intermittent-amber-form.** Statutory-fiscal-discipline appears in
  form with non-transparent-amendment-statistics with intermediate-period exceptions.
- **Modern-market-statistical-disclosure dis-amber-tendency.** Patterns-of-modern-market-
  statistical-disclosure (cross-economy-class data on credit, capital allocation, public
  procurement) trending-not-published whereas opacity-statistical-of-the-cultural fit-statistical
  reasoning visible in audit.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Wilber, *Integral Psychology* (altitude/amber); Beck & Cowan, *Spiral Dynamics*
  (ethnocentric stabilization); Commons/MHC Order 8 (Primary); Kegan, *In Over Our Heads*
  (order 3→4); North, *Institutions, Institutional Change and Economic Performance* (the
  generic-form of the discipline); Acemoglu & Robinson, *Why Nations Fail* (extractivist-
  inclusive-generic form); North in the descriptive-political-economy form; Khan, *Political
  Settlements*; *Rent-Seeking* literature; Lindert, *Growing Public*; Ben-Ner, *For-Profit
  Sociology*; Dimaggio & Powell's *Iron-Cage-Revisited* literature.

- **Open joints:** What institutional carriers carry the amber economic-domain's *positive*
  modern-moments (the modern market-statute, the regulatory-statute apparatus) into the orange
  turn? What structural pre-conditions are required for an in-group-dominant distribution frame
  to dismount its loyalty-leaning without destabilizing the standing-infrastructure that the
  orange turn requires to function?
- **Research debt:** bracket this rung with `economic-systems/08-preoperational` and
  `economic-systems/11-abstract-emerge`; cross-link the `governance` line at Stage 9
